title: Digital Input (Single Sample)
text: Acquire single sample from multiple digital lines of data acquisition device, 2 outputs, {Number of ports} sets Number of output data ports 1 for all lines; {Device}, {Lines} sets the device line selection and configuration options depend, {Sample time} sets the block execution rate and {Output timestamp} adds timestamp output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: Device from which you want to acquire data

params.name: Lines
params.values: Device line selection and configuration options depend on device

params.name: Number of ports
params.values: Number of output data ports 1 for all lines | 1 per line
